answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, split across independent auditors, idle agents bleed standing. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the ledge of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Every claim climbs the zephyr of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the nectar re-runs the work instead of trusting the label.
